observations: Two photos show a stainless steel 3-burner gas cooker with black grates and burners.
The front panel has three black control knobs.
A label with safety and usage instructions is visible on the front right side.
The surface shows minor scratches and smudges, especially on the left burner.
The cooktop appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or dents.
The seller claims it is 'fairly used' and 'working perfectly'.

claims.claim: Direct uk fairly used 3 burner gas cooker working perfectly
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

risks.proof: A video showing all three burners lit and operating smoothly.

risks.risk: The gas may be damaged or have a faulty regulator, which cannot be seen in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the gas being ignited and the flame being adjusted by the knobs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unsafe or non-functional

risks.risk: The cooktop may have hidden damage or wear not visible in the photos, such as cracked grates or damaged burners.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each burner and grate, especially the edges and joints.

proof_requests: Video showing all three burners lit and operating smoothly.
Close-up photos of each burner and grate, especially the edges and joints.
Photo of the gas regulator or valve if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
